messages.subject: code for full likelihood approach
parts:
I would like to relate experimental design covariates to observations) using the integrated likelihood approach.

I’m using Oedekoven etal (2013) as my tutorial/model and Buckland etal (2015) as a reference.


It appears that this approach is not included in either Distance 7.1 for Windows, and not facilitated in Package Distance (Miller 2017). Am I missing something?


I have the R code Oedekoven made available as a supplement.

The outlines of the code are clear, but many of the details are less so, which makes adapting her code for my data error prone and difficult. 

Is this code supplement the best (ie., most user-friendly) option available?


Thanks for any suggestions.


John Shepherd
